name: browser-use
headline: NotebookLM YouTube Skill - Automate Research
short_description: Automates research and notebook creation from YouTube videos. Identifies featured people, adds sources, and generates audio overviews. Connects to NotebookLM and Claude for research and automation workflows.
author: BayramAnnakov

sections.overview:
This skill automates the process of converting YouTube videos into NotebookLM notebooks with generated audio overviews. It extracts people mentioned in videos, researches their backgrounds via web search, and creates a notebook containing the video transcript and research documents. The skill uses screenshot-based automation to interact with NotebookLM's interface, making it ideal for researchers, podcasters, and content creators who want to transform interviews, talks, and documentaries into searchable, listenable formats. Works with Claude Desktop and requires Chrome browser with NotebookLM access.
Convert interview videos into searchable notebooks with speaker research
Generate podcast-style audio overviews from educational talks and lectures
Automate research documentation for documentary and news video content
Create study materials from YouTube educational content with speaker context

sections.usage:
```
Create a research notebook from this YouTube video: [YOUTUBE_VIDEO_URL]. Identify key speakers, summarize main points, and generate an audio overview. Connect to NotebookLM for structured notes and Claude for additional insights. Focus on [TOPIC] in the [INDUSTRY] sector.
```
Copy

